name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo Velez's journey into motorsport finance was unconventional. After earning his MBA, he spent several years in corporate finance, but a lifelong passion for racing drew him to the track. He started volunteering at local races, quickly realizing the financial intricacies of motorsport teams. This led him to pursue opportunities in the racing world, eventually landing at Elite Motorsport.

Ricardo's approach is rooted in practicality and a deep understanding of the sport. He prioritizes data-driven decisions and clear communication, ensuring that financial strategies align with the team's on-track goals. He's known for his ability to navigate complex financial situations with calm efficiency, a trait that has proven invaluable in the high-pressure environment of motorsport.

What sets Ricardo apart is his commitment to mentorship. He actively seeks out young talent, guiding them through the complexities of motorsport finance and fostering the next generation of financial experts in the sport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always has a spreadsheet open, even during meetings.
Collects miniature die-cast race cars and displays them on his desk.
Insists on using a specific brand of green tea, which he brews in his office.
